authoring_method: Each sampled product was read individually and converted by hand into natural shopping language. Messages were not generated by evaluator code or catalog-field templates.

messages: I'm exploring women's blouses for warm weather that could work both casually and at the office.
I'd like a soft, breathable crop top with an off-shoulder neckline and lace short sleeves.
A drawstring fit would be useful, and it should also look appropriate for a party or beach day.
I need black protective work footwear for an industrial construction site, with a reinforced safety toe and a fit around EU size 42.
It can be a unisex design, but safety and durability matter more than appearance.
I'm shopping for a gold-tone ankle bracelet as a gift, with a heart and the letter B.
It should be suitable for a teen or adult and preferably carry a 925 metal marking.
Help me find men's costume headwear for a police-officer outfit.
I'm after the traditional rounded British bobby look rather than a modern baseball-style cap.
I want a simple pair of women's flip-flops for casual summer and beach use.
A lightweight synthetic-and-fabric upper with a man-made sole is fine.
I need a women's low-top everyday sneaker with a relaxed fit and rubber sole.
Please prioritize a vegan design with air-cooled cushioning and moisture-management features.
I'm looking for a women's closed-heel slip-on work shoe for long professional shifts.
It needs a slip-resistant, non-marking sole, a stain-resistant upper, and elastic side panels for easy on and off.
I'd like an inexpensive coordinated necklace and earring set for a wedding or formal event.
Gold coloring with clear sparkling stones and a teardrop shape would suit the outfit.
Keep it near $10 if possible, with dangling earrings and an adjustable necklace length.
I need a breathable cotton neck gaiter and face-covering bundle for running and cycling in dusty or windy conditions.
It should include replaceable filters and work in several ways, such as a bandana, headband, balaclava, or wrist covering.
I'm exploring elegant women's pumps for dressy occasions.
I'd prefer premium leather, a heel around two and a half inches, and extra padding under the front of the foot.
A lightweight flexible sole and an interesting mix of smooth and textured leather would be ideal.
I want a very slim, lightweight wallet that would be practical for boating, fishing, or kayaking.
It should resist water, float if dropped, and hold roughly eight cards plus some cash.
Storage for SD and micro-SD cards would be a useful bonus.
At first I thought I wanted a compact, plain handbag for carrying only daily essentials.
Something understated and small still sounds sensible.
Actually, forget that. I need a large top-handle bag with artwork printed on both sides and enough room for a laptop or tablet.
Two main zippered compartments plus inner phone storage would help keep work files and cosmetics organized.
I need a women's ankle-height fashion boot with about a three-inch heel.
Please look for cushioning for all-day comfort, a traction outsole, and some woven or braided detailing.
I'm looking for a men's long-sleeve button-down shirt that stays presentable through a full workday without wrinkling badly.
A rayon and polyester microfiber blend with a chest pocket, button cuffs, and a subtle houndstooth pattern would be good.
Help me choose a roomy women's leather wallet with a zipper running around the outside.
I'd like pebbled cow leather, expandable sides, a small gold-tone logo, and a light gray or cement color.
I'm initially looking at casual flat shoes that I can wear for relaxed weekends.
A sporty fabric style might be easiest.
Actually, change of plan: I need a leather slingback pump for work or formal wear, with a heel a little over two inches.
A tapered toe, adjustable buckle, cushioned footbed, and textured rubber sole are important.
I'm browsing women's camisoles or tank tops that can be used as a simple layering piece.
I don't have a strong material preference, so use your judgment.
A classic bra-strap design in a large size and a white, navy, or burgundy color combination would work.
I'm looking around for a men's pullover hoodie that can handle cold and windy weather.
It should use heavyweight fleece with a soft brushed interior, a roomy lined hood, and ribbed cuffs.
A large front hand-warmer pocket and some recycled fiber content would be welcome.
I first considered a short black vampire cloak for a child's costume.
A dark dramatic style was the original idea.
Actually, switch that completely: I need a green cape about 39 inches long for an adult or teenager.
It should be smooth stretchy polyester with a tie closure, suitable for a superhero, elf, wizard, or Halloween costume, and cost around $15.
I need warm brown women's snow boots in size 9 for winter.
Please focus on a medium-width, mid-calf design with a platform-style heel.
